$comment: Line Harness ontology: the single source for routing, quota, review and permission rules. Consumers: Line Hub (routeAdvice, alert RULES), CLAUDE.md generated blocks, ontology-check sensor. Edit here, then run ontology-check --write. Owner: Line. Values copied from the live system on 2026-11-15.

defectCategories.label: Contradictory requirements
defectCategories.countermeasure: Resolve conflicts between criteria, constraints, fixtures, and tests, and give each term one meaning.

defectCategories.label: Sandbox validation
defectCategories.countermeasure: Provide validation commands that run in the worker sandbox or name the steps the supervisor must run on the host.

defectCategories.label: Salvage and fresh sessions
defectCategories.countermeasure: Include stop rules and a salvage note, and request a fresh session after a sub-agent thread.

defectCategories.label: UI width coverage
defectCategories.countermeasure: Test UI widths of 320, 400, 640, 1024, and 1440 pixels with no horizontal overflow or clipped text.

defectCategories.label: Documentation style
defectCategories.countermeasure: Require STE short sentences, active voice, and no non-STE words, and name the STE check.

defectCategories.label: File encoding
defectCategories.countermeasure: Specify UTF-8 without BOM and LF or the repository line ending when changing non-ASCII text.

defectCategories.label: Documentation synchronization
defectCategories.countermeasure: Include documents that quote counts, file names, or rules in FILES and update them with the code.

defectCategories.label: Source of truth
defectCategories.countermeasure: Read each value from its source of truth and name every fallback instead of using silent defaults.

defectCategories.label: Concurrency and ordering
defectCategories.countermeasure: State concurrency, cache, and ordering behaviour and require a test for each.

defectCategories.label: Fixture secret gates
defectCategories.countermeasure: Use dummy fixture values shorter than the secret-gate pattern and omit console.log.

defectCategories.label: Real execution path
defectCategories.countermeasure: Include at least one criterion that runs the real stack, real data, or a real run beyond mocks or holds.

defectCategories.label: Formatter and static checks
defectCategories.countermeasure: Run the repository formatter, lint, and typecheck on changed files in VALIDATE.

defectCategories.label: Environment and tools
defectCategories.countermeasure: Name every environment variable and tool required by the build and run steps.

defectCategories.label: Scope control
defectCategories.countermeasure: Bound the work with FILES and NON-GOALS and forbid rewriting lines outside the change.

defectCategories.label: PowerShell 5.1 traps
defectCategories.countermeasure: Address PowerShell 5.1 array unrolling, paths with spaces, and $PSScriptRoot parameter defaults, and validate syntax with powershell -NoProfile -File ~/.claude/bin/ps-parse-check.ps1 <file...> instead of an inline parser call.

defectCategories.label: Missing success criterion
defectCategories.countermeasure: Write one testable SUCCESS CRITERIA line for every behaviour the change must keep or add.

defectCategories.label: Unverified completion claim
defectCategories.countermeasure: Ask the worker to paste the command output for every claim of done.

defectCategories.label: Logic defect
defectCategories.countermeasure: Give a worked example with input and expected output for each non-trivial rule.

defectCategories.label: Other defect
defectCategories.countermeasure: Describe the defect in the finding title.

lessons.rule: Name the 390 px and 1440 px checks in VALIDATE, require no horizontal overflow and no clipped text, and have the supervisor screenshot both before PASS.
List every file the change must touch, including shared helpers, and tell the worker to STOP and name the file when it needs another one.
Name the source of truth for every value the change reads and the fallback when it is missing; never copy constants by hand.
Mark which VALIDATE commands run in the worker sandbox and which the supervisor runs on the host, and pass the repo root as -Dir.
When code must read model output, ask the model for a JSON block and validate it against a schema; never parse free text with regex.
Every claim of done and every count in a survey carries the command output or the file:line that proves it.
State the ordering, locking and retry behaviour for shared files and hooks, and test two writers at the same time.

first_pass.label: Clean first pass
first_pass.definition: A ledger task with fail_rounds = 0 and L1 + L2 + L3 findings = 0.

models.name: Fable 5.2

models.name: GPT-6.1 Sol

tiers.when: under ~20 lines of config, typo, docs
1-2 files, runnable VALIDATE, single-branch logic, worked examples
3+ files, long command chains, repo discovery, vague VALIDATE, prior Sol STOP/FAIL

tiers.preRead: Fable subagent reads the packet before dispatch

quota.paceDefinition: pace = used % / % of the window elapsed; ignored in the first 5% of a window

codexLevels.test: pace > codexPace1 (to codexPace2) or used codexUsed1..codexUsed2-1
codexLevels.route: Standard-B with <= 3 files and a runnable VALIDATE goes to `gpt-6-sol` high. No Luna exploration (Claude Explore subagent). Layer 2 = Fable subagent.
codexLevels.label: Pace > {codexPace1} to {codexPace2}, used {codexUsed1}-{codexUsed2-1}%

codexLevels.route: Codex for Important/Critical. Standard work goes to an Opus subagent with the same packet (if Claude is stressed too, see below). No resumes.
codexLevels.label: Pace > {codexPace2} or used {codexUsed2}-{codexUsed3-1}%

codexLevels.route: No Codex. Grok worker via codex-do (auto at used >= {codexUsed3}%): Standard, Important and Exploration; Critical worker = Opus subagent; layer 2 = Grok review (codex-review.ps1 auto) + Fable subagent; ledger `worker=grok-4.7-build-fast`.
codexLevels.label: Used >= {codexUsed3}%

claudeRules.test: Claude 7-day pace > claudePace or used >= claudeUsed
claudeRules.text: No Opus subagent workers (except the Critical worker when Codex used >= codexUsed3); layer 2 = Astra (Fable subagent when Codex used >= codexUsed3); Fable otherwise only for Critical layer 3; supervisor edits <= 20 lines.
claudeRules.bullet: Claude 7-day pace > {claudePace} or used >= {claudeUsed}%: no Opus subagent workers (except the Critical worker when Codex used >= {codexUsed3}%); layer 2 = Astra (Fable subagent when Codex used >= {codexUsed3}%); Fable otherwise only for Critical layer 3; supervisor edits <= 20 lines.

claudeRules.text: Standard-A and Standard-B go to gpt-6-sol high and are never deferred.
claudeRules.bullet: Both sides stressed (Claude rule above active and Codex not >= {codexUsed3}%): Standard-A and Standard-B go to `gpt-6-sol` high and are never deferred (Line, 2026-11-15).

claudeRules.text: Grok workers continue; layer 2 = Fable subagent; report to Line.
claudeRules.bullet: Codex used >= {codexUsed3}% while the Claude rule is active: Grok workers continue; layer 2 = Fable subagent; report to Line.

claudeRules.text: Finish the current check, update the handoff, pause Claude work until the window resets.
claudeRules.bullet: Claude 5-hour used >= {claude5Used}%: finish the current check, update the handoff, pause Claude work until the window resets.

claudeRules.text: Stop and report to Line. Codex desktop and CLI sessions count against the budget.
claudeRules.bullet: Codex desktop and CLI sessions count against the budget. One session over 50M tokens: stop and report to Line.

quota.templateRules: Placeholders {key} take quota.thresholds[key]; {key-1} subtracts 1; keys containing "Pace" print with at least one decimal (1 -> 1.0, 1.3 -> 1.3); others print as integers.

labels.sbCond: gpt-6-sol high if <=3 files and runnable VALIDATE, else gpt-6-astra high

routing.stopText: No new packets; report to Line
routing.fallback: gpt-6-astra xhigh, one attempt, then replan. Never start at xhigh.
routing.k5Banner: Claude 5-hour >= {claude5Used}%: finish the current check, update the handoff, pause Claude work until the window resets

alerts.$comment: Line Hub rules a-h. Toasts never stop work.

actions.note: supervisor copies verified repo files into ~/.claude or ~/.codex after layer 3
only when Line orders that exact action in the current conversation
never pick the target branch; ask Line
two written confirmations + backup + restore plan
only openai/gpt-6-luna runs; exceptions need OPENROUTER_GUARD_OVERRIDE=1 and Line naming model + budget
sessions always run; Windows ends a process if memory truly runs out
compaction handles context; at 85%+ update the handoff silently

retired.why: codegraph MCP removed (4 calls in 30 days)
optional beep; codex-do already plays a toast and a sound

rules.text: Important and Critical ledger lines require layer 2 unless an explicit waiver is recorded in the note.
rules.note: Intent: enforce Line's review gate. Status: implemented. Next: supervisor installation. Blockers: none. Confidence: fixture tests.

rules.text: Codex resumes above 50,000,000 total tokens exit 76; missing usage warns and continues.
rules.note: Intent: enforce Line's session cap. Status: implemented. Next: supervisor installation. Blockers: none. Confidence: fixture tests.

rules.text: Always pass the repo ROOT as -Dir; one worker per repo at a time.
rules.note: codex-do Dir lock only blocks two workers in one Dir; nothing forces the repo root yet

rules.text: Write every ledger line with ledger-add.ps1 -SpecFile <packet>.
After 2 FAILs at Important/Critical (3 at Standard) stop, report to Line, redesign.
The RAM check reports commit headroom only; it never blocks, waits or stops.
Silent below 85% context; at 85%+ update the handoff and keep working.
Layer 2 counts only from explicit evidence: ledger field 3 'yes', or a stated L2 result; GATES-PASS is not a model review.
codegraph is removed; use Grep and line-range Read for code.
